rule: the 24 F scenes are grouped by whole capture session (sessions never split). Enumerate every assignment of the sessions to 4 non-empty folds; choose the one minimising (1) the fold-size range (max - min), then (2) the summed squared deviation of each fold's Auto-WB fraction from the F-wide Auto fraction, then (3) the lexically smallest sorted tuple of session lists. Rare WB modes confined to one session (White Fluorescent / Cloudy: session 3 only) cannot be stratified.
unstratifiable: White Fluorescent (DSCF0514) and Cloudy (DSCF0511) occur only in session 3
